Sivad Johnson Mayor Sheffield announces sweeping plan to bring thousands more 1-2 family rental units up to code Mayor, developer & community celebrate opening of Rohns Apartments, bringing 17 new affordable units Detroit Community Health Improvement Process The Community Health Improvement Plan (CHIP) is a strategic, community-driven blueprint designed to work within the City’s Health in All Policies (HiAP) framework. The strategies outlined in the CHIP will be anchored by the Detroit Health Department, in collaboration with City departments, and carried out in partnership with the community to drive necessary changes in policies, systems and environments across every district.
